items.title: Aon partners with Right Fuel Card Company to target SME hauliers
items.summary: Aon has agreed a partnership with Right Fuel Card Company to offer insurance and risk reviews to small and medium-sized fleet operators.

items.title: East Sussex Pension Fund appoints Louise Davey as independent person
items.summary: The Local Government Pension Scheme fund has named Louise Davey to the independent role starting next month.

items.title: Edinburgh Worldwide and Impax Environmental trusts propose merger under Saba management
items.summary: Edinburgh Worldwide Investment Trust and Impax Environmental Markets have proposed merging under New York hedge fund Saba Capital alongside a tender offer.

items.title: EY forecasts UK motor insurers to pay £1.08 in claims for every £1 of premium in 2026
items.summary: Consultancy Angelica Solutions is urging motor and home insurers to bridge the gap between pricing and reserving models to protect profitability.

items.title: JM Finn chief executive Hugo Bedford to retire
items.summary: Wealth management firm JM Finn has confirmed that chief executive Hugo Bedford is stepping down, with Dominic May lined up as interim successor.

items.title: Gore Street Energy Storage chair Angus Gordon Lennox to resign
items.summary: Angus Gordon Lennox is stepping down as chair and non-executive director of the Gore Street Energy Storage trust after a tenure of one year.
